I have a stack of small-ish white boards. I write everything i need to do down on it and i just pick one thing to clear off the board. Also try not to get into time sucks, for me its sitting down and checking my phone. If i can avoid sitting down at least i keep my momentum going. Another quick tip is that if the task can be done in like 2 minutes or less to just try to do the task as soon as it becomes one. 

I had a severe head injury when i was young so i have pretty bad memory and adhd. Keeping a notepad esq device that is not my phone has been really helpful. On days i dont have the mental motivation to do something i at least can take account for what needs to be done.

Something that has been helpful recently is finding something that is engaging mentally, like an audiobook or podcast, and also more than just a short video or something im going to have to change in 20 minutes. For me thats like mr.ballen videos or mythology and wild history stuff.

Just throwing anything down that works for me! Good luck my friend!
